scope: descriptive archived training OOF only; no independent generalization claim

hypotheses.H1: Composition-matched experts favor different local charge/hydrophobic organizations; isolated predicted geometry is only a proxy, not membrane-bound structure.
hypotheses.H2: Expert disagreement and fusion harm may track confidence, seed disagreement or sequence-neighborhood proxy rather than a new biological mechanism.
hypotheses.H3: Persistently wrong low-Cys positives or high-Cys negatives after evidence stratification may reveal endpoint, modification or disulfide/oligomer-state information missing from the retained inputs. Annotation must not be fabricated.

matching.order: fewest eligible controls then source_index; nearest standardized distance

statistics.BH_family: all primary contrast-feature tests; stricter sensitivity separate exploratory family
statistics.cross_fold_directions: report available folds and discovery0-2 versus3-4, no claim of blinded replication

limitations: operating thresholds/calibration use all retained OOF labels
historical upstream checkpoint selection not certified nested
fold/source/family/endpoint confounding not eliminated by matching
Cys number is not experimentally known disulfide connectivity
no pLDDT cutoff or reweighting rule selected using these results
new UniProt function annotations are leads, not gold endpoint labels
